missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Пожар' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'начался'. 'Большой' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'ночью' fixes the time. A clean event card.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Пожар' is an inanimate masculine noun, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'потушили'. 'Быстро' adds the manner. A natural action pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive with 'из-за'. 'Пожара' takes the genitive after the causal 'из-за' to mean because of the fire. 'Сгорел старый дом' is the result. A common cause pattern.

missions.phrase: Люди бежали к пожару с вёдрами.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative with 'к'. 'К пожару' uses the dative form 'пожару' to show movement toward the fire. 'С вёдрами' is the instrumental of accompaniment. A natural motion-toward pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of agent. 'Пожаром' takes the instrumental to express the means or agent of destruction with the passive 'было уничтожено'. 'Здание' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О пожаре' uses the prepositional 'пожаре' after 'о' to express reporting about the fire. 'По радио' gives the channel. A useful media pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after 'два'. After the numeral 'два' the masculine noun takes the genitive singular 'пожара'. 'На складе' sets the place. A key number-noun rule.

missions.phrase: Летом в лесу часто бывают пожары.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Пожары' is the nominative plural subject of 'бывают'. 'Часто' adds frequency, and 'в лесу' sets the place. A clean plural model.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject with accusative object. 'Пожары' is the nominative plural subject of 'уничтожили'. 'Эти' agrees, and 'целые деревни' is the accusative plural object.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural with 'с'. 'С пожарами' uses the instrumental plural 'пожарами' after 'бороться с' to mean fighting the fires. 'Лесными' agrees in the plural.
